reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Acct Sign-in is Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign into your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

reauth_code_from_applecom_login.title: Get an Authentication Code from Apple.com
reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Acct Sign-in is Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign into your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

reauth_code_from_applecom_login.title: Get an Authentication Code from Apple.com
reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Acct Sign-in is Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign into your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

confirm.title: iCloud3: Switch to the iCloud3 Repository ({store})
confirm.description:
iCloud3 was installed from the *iCloud3 Beta* repository (gcobb321/icloud3_v3). That repository is no longer updated. The iCloud3 beta versions are now pre-releases in the *iCloud3* repository (gcobb321/icloud3).

Select **Submit** to switch your {store} installation to the iCloud3 repository with its *Pre-release* switch on so you continue to receive the beta versions.

- Nothing is uninstalled or downloaded and Home Assistant does not need to be restarted
- The iCloud3 configuration, devices and entities are not changed
- The *iCloud3 Beta* update entity is replaced by the *iCloud3* update entity
- Turn the iCloud3 *Pre-release* switch off later to only receive the production versions

3. *{store} > iCloud3*, Install (Download) it.
4. Restart Home Assistant.
5. *Settings > Devices & services > Add Integration > iCloud3*, add it again.
6. Optional, turn on the iCloud3 *Pre-release* switch to receive the beta versions.
